hook: brands that almost never go on sale
hook_say: these brands basically never go on sale. this week they are, and a few of them say it's the only time all year.
sub: every quote is from the brand's own site

brands.say: merit. they call this their only sale of the year. twenty percent off, twenty-five if you spend over one fifty. if you've been waiting on the flush balm, this is the week.
freja, the bags. twenty-five percent off everything, and they call it their annual event. the black chrystie is the one i'd get.

brands.stat: "our best offer of the year" · ends sunday
brands.say: tatcha. twenty-five off the whole site, in their words their best offer of the year. it ends sunday, so that's a day before most of these.

brands.stat: "the biggest sale of the year" · $150 min
brands.say: jennifer behr, the headbands and bows. twenty-five off, they say it's their biggest sale of the year. catch: your cart has to hit one fifty, and some of the bows are one forty-eight.

brands.stat: "our only sale of the year" · thru monday
brands.say: lazy jamie. tiny store, eleven things, twenty percent off through monday, their only sale of the year. the phone chair is a real chair for your phone and i think it's funny.

brands.stat: "our only sale of the year" · code THESEASON
brands.say: past midnight sunglasses. their only sale of the year, twenty-five off with the code theseason. you have to type the code, the prices on the site still look full.

brands.stat: "our only sitewide sale of the year"
brands.say: and margaux. twenty percent off everything, their only sitewide sale of the year. twenty isn't a big number, but the demi flat is on my feet at full price the other fifty-one weeks.

close_say: none of these are huge numbers. the point is you won't see them again until next november. which brand do you wait all year for?
caption: Seven brands that almost never discount are on sale this week, and four of them call it their only sale of the year. The discounts are 20 to 25%, mostly through Monday. Which brand do you wait all year for? Commissionable links in bio.
